headline.text: L3 ML4 flagged *three* foreign-material concerns — cardboard in filter, cooler 3 covers off with loose bolts, worn auger guard.

summary: Three foreign-material flags on L3 ML4 (cardboard found in filter, cooler 3 covers potentially off during production with bolts loose in corners, worn guard on licking roller 2 auger), plus almond dust cross-contact residue flagged at L2 FFS during cleaning. No active holds.

food_safety.title: Cardboard found in PTL 2 filter
food_safety.summary: Cardboard found in filter during investigation for potentially lost plastic bearing; team confirms second bearing was not actually lost after check.
food_safety.status: Cardboard removed from filter; plastic bearing investigation closed — second bearing confirmed not lost.

food_safety.title: Cooler 3 covers off, loose bolts in corners
food_safety.summary: Plastic covers found off cooler 3 when 3rd shift opened for cleaning; bolts sitting loose in corners; potentially ran with covers off Wednesday.
food_safety.status: Open, awaiting investigation to confirm whether line ran with covers off.

food_safety.title: Worn guard on licking roller 2 auger
food_safety.summary: Wear marks observed on auger guard after cleaning licking roller 2; documented with photo during shift 2 cleaning.
food_safety.status: Flagged for maintenance assessment; no immediate action taken.

sanitation.title: Gondola cleaning handoff unclear
sanitation.summary: 3rd shift found gondola parts left by prior shift with unclear completion status; shift supervisor asked which shift cleaned it.
sanitation.status: Resolved — Level 2 clean completed and passed final verification by QA at 06:57.

allergen.title: Almond dust in FFS vibratory loader
allergen.summary: Almond dust residue observed in FFS vibratory loader during sorting area cleaning; team flagged for cleaning before Tuesday product run.
allergen.status: Identified during weekend clean; cleaning scheduled before next product changeover Tuesday.

opportunities.text: Consider adding allergen residue inspection to FFS area post-clean checklist before product changeover — based on almond dust found in vibratory loader during weekend sorting-area clean.
Consider adding cooler cover and fastener integrity check to ML4 pre-shift walk — based on cooler 3 covers found off with bolts loose in corners after potentially running Wednesday.
Review gondola cleaning sign-off protocol to ensure completion status is visible at shift handoff — based on unclear status when 3rd shift opened for Level 2 clean.
